run_dense_eval_hybrid: run the dense_eval script to compute hybrid ML+DFT AdsorbML success rates for top-k configurations
run_dense_eval_ml_only: run the dense_eval script with --ml-success to compute validated ML-only success rates
compute_hybrid_success: compute AdsorbML hybrid success rates at varying top-k values comparing ML+DFT energies to ground truth
compute_valid_ml_success: compute validated ML success rates by checking if ML energies are within 0.1 eV of DFT
filter_ml_data: filter ML data by setting missing systems or configs to high energy values for failure handling
